TSXV:TAO (OTCQB: TAOIF) (FSE: T0P) ("TAG Oil" or the "Company") is pleased to report the filing of its financial results for the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026. At September 30, 2026, the Company had C$7.8 million in cash and cash equivalents and C$5.0 million in working capital. The Company has no debt. Capital expenditures were C$5,163,000 in the quarter and C$5,582,000 for the nine months, primarily on exploration and evaluation on the T-200 well. The cash balance reflects the C$11.5 million brokered private placement completed on February 18, 2026.
During the three months ended September 30, 2026, two Badr Oil Field ("
") wells produced an average of 66 barrels of oil per day(1). Crude oil sales delivered from BED-1 for the same period was 53 barrels of oil per day.
The Company commenced drilling the T-200 vertical well at BED-1 on August 6, 2026, targeting the naturally fractured Abu Roash "F" ("

") reservoir. Subsequent to September 30, 2026, the well reached a final total depth of 4,160 meters. The Company conducted a high-pressure acid stimulation to improve wellbore clean-up and restore communication with the reservoir and its natural fractures. An artificial lift jet pump system was installed and started lifting operations on November 24, 2026. The plan is to produce the well for several days to establish a stabilized average initial production rate. The Company will report results following testing of the well.
